verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost identical and share the same flaws. The pills are scattered in a staggered arrangement, with Blood Orange dropped below Cucumber Mint, so they no longer read as one row. The Shop Flavours CTA floats off-centre to the right and lines up with neither the left-aligned headline nor the pills. The fine print is too small to read and is centred on a different axis from the copy. The empty bottom-left corner and the stray circle leave the balance lopsided. B wins only marginally: it adds a little more space between the subhead and the CTA and sits slightly lower, so A's cramped subhead-to-CTA gap and larger dead area at the bottom are a bit worse.
